THE INCIDENT OCCURRED ON 03JULY2024, AT 0334 PACIFIC TIME AT THE FOLLOWING LOCATION IN FEDERAL WATERS WITHIN THE MORROW BAY. WIND ENERGY AREA IN LEASE OCS-P0564 AND THE CLIENT IS GOLDEN STATE WIND. 35.63240814 N -121.862119 W
